name: web-productivity-hero-with-sticky-note-3d-tiles-and-folder-widgets
title: Textured white hero 'Think, plan, and track all in one place' with a pinned sticky note, 3D icon tiles and folder-shaped widgets in the corners
whatItIs: A white page with a dotted grey textured field, a centred headline in black and grey, a blue Get free demo button, a logo tile with four dots at the top centre, a yellow pinned note with handwriting and a blue check tile at the left, a stopwatch tile and a reminders folder at the right, and folder-shaped widgets at the bottom for today's tasks and integrations.
whatItMeans: Playful yet tidy; tactile desk objects make software feel like a well-organised desk.
techniques: Scatter desk-object widgets around a centred headline.
Use a two-tone headline in black and grey.

vocabulary.definition: A yellow pinned note as a UI element.
A card shaped like a folder tab.
A headline in black and lighter grey.
A fine dot pattern on the background.
